name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
title: Apcotex Industries Ltd - 523694 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA up 42% to INR 55 cr on Nitrile latex margin spike that management calls partly a March war blip; NBR at 100% utilisation, no major capacity until FY28, ADD not notified.

utilisation.quote: for Q4, I am talking about Q4, not for the whole financial year, but for Q4, we were between 90% and 100% across all our plants

capex.quote: FY '27, no. Most of this capacity will come on stream in FY '28.

triggers.label: Q4 utilisation 90-100% across plants
triggers.quote: we were between 90% and 100% across all our plants, all our factories

triggers.label: Nitrile latex capacity step-up deferred to FY28
triggers.quote: if that capacity comes on stream, it will be in the next financial year, not this financial year

triggers.label: Nitrile margins temporary March spike
triggers.quote: that may be partly because of this war situation. So, we are waiting to see how things land

triggers.label: Chinese latex entering Egypt and Turkey
triggers.quote: For the first time, we are seeing in Turkey and Egypt, for example, Chinese latex coming in there

guidance.value: double-digit to low double-digit volume growth
guidance.quote: if the demand is there and we do have capacity to grow by another in double- digits, low double-digits in volume for the whole year

guidance.value: better than average of last year
guidance.quote: we expect margins to be better than the average of last year, at least for this coming year
we will continue to grow at double digits

red_flags.label: Margin spike partly one-month war windfall
red_flags.quote: especially the month of March could have been a little bit of a blip

red_flags.label: Working capital reversal risk
red_flags.quote: some of it now will be sucked back into working capital

evasions.quote: I do not have the EBITDA number.
So, I do not have any number for you in terms of giving guidance for Nitrile latex margins
